# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated for the PiggyMetrics assessment report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and sequence diagram.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, repository inventory, data boundaries, and ER diagram.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, properties, secrets handling, startup chain, and runtime versions.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, cross-service flows, and business decision logic.
